title: RubRIX: Rubric-Driven Risk Mitigation in Caregiver-AI Interactions
measurement_description: The paper evaluates bias based on religious assumptions as one of 29 risk components in its 'RubRIX' framework. Specifically, it audits LLM responses for expressing bias based on religion, using examples like 'Assuming Western family structures, ignoring cultural care practices, religious assumptions, ethnocentric recommendations'.
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religious bias. However, it reports that its rubric-guided refinement process led to substantial reductions in the 'Bias & Stigma' risk dimension, which includes religious bias. This dimension saw risk reductions of 83-100% on the ADRD-Caregiver dataset and 77-100% on the General-Caregiver dataset, among the most significant improvements across all risk categories.
